evidence.assignment_level_manifest_cardinality_ch: result_row_counts is keyed only by assignment_id and rejects any count other than one
evidence.contradicted_authority_rule: A later fresh retry may qualify with a new attempt number and new identity while failed attempts remain immutable
evidence.consequence: An assignment with one preserved failed manifest row plus one valid fresh-retry manifest row can never receive v2 credit.
evidence.crosscheck_gap: The cross-check validates only the credited set reported by v2 and does not independently recompute omitted eligible attempts, so it cannot detect this under-credit.
evidence.missing_evidence_alias: evidence_parts accepts quote, excerpt, exact_excerpt, and exact_quote but omits exact_text, a live runner output field for verbatim evidence.
evidence.credit_safety: The defect is fail-closed; it does not invalidate the 17 assignments already reproduced by the independent cross-check.

required_fix: Group result manifests and cardinality by normalized assignment plus attempt plus fresh identity, not assignment alone.
Independently recompute all eligible attempts in the cross-check rather than validating only the primary credited subset.
Normalize exact_text as an exact-evidence quote alias.
Preserve v2 and its evidence as immutable lineage.
